# True Inspire

True Inspire is an independent web design and development studio in Odisha, India. The studio designs and builds business websites, education and event experiences, digital products, and technical web foundations.

## Primary pages

- / — Studio overview, selected work, services, process, and founders.
- /work/ — Project archive.
- /services/ — Business websites, education and events, digital products, and performance foundations.
- /studio/ — Founder and studio information.
- /contact/ — Local project-brief tool and verified founder contact routes.
- /privacy/ — Current handling of project-brief data and external links.

## Important accuracy notes

- Project artwork in the archive is editorial title artwork; each case study identifies its verified scope and destinations.
- The project-brief form currently prepares information in the visitor's browser. It does not deliver entries to a True Inspire server.
- Contact links point to the founders' verified external profiles.
